cases.purpose: Preserve leading, embedded and trailing NUL, newline and high-bit bytes in decoded frames of all types.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PYEND'
import struct
from pathlib import Path
payload = bytes([0, 65, 255, 0, 10, 66, 0])
for kind, name in enumerate(('pty', 'query', 'control'), 1):
    Path(name + '.frame').write_bytes(b'BSCR' + bytes([1, kind]) + struct.pack('>I', len(payload)) + payload)
    Path(name + '.expected').write_bytes(('type=%s\nlen=%d\npayload=' % (name, len(payload))).encode() + payload + b'\n')
PYEND
for type in pty query control; do
    screen remote-frame decode < "$type.frame" > "$type.actual" || exit 1
    /usr/bin/cmp -s "$type.expected" "$type.actual" || exit 1
    printf '%s-binary=PASS\n' "$type"
done
cases.oracle: Independent struct-packed frames and length-delimited expected output, compared byte for byte.
cases.comparison: Compare complete binary output and exit status for each frame type.
